<translate>
The '''Dragon Radar''' locates the scattered Dragon Balls so you can gather all seven and summon a dragon (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragons and Wishes|Dragons and Wishes]]). Each world has its own radar: the Earth radar finds the Earth Dragon Balls for [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]], the Namek radar finds the Namek Dragon Balls for [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]], and the '''Bi-Dimensional Radar''' works in both worlds.
</translate>

<translate>
== Radars ==
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Radar</translate> !! <translate>Works in</translate> !! <translate>Finds</translate> !! <translate>How to get it</translate>
|-
| <translate>Dragon Radar (Earth)</translate> || {{L|Earth}} || <translate>Earth Dragon Balls</translate> || <translate>Crafted from Radar's Chips (Earth) and a Radar's CPU (Earth). Also the reward of Bulma's '''Radar Upgrade''' sidequest and of the [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] quest '''Parts for Bulma'''.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Dragon Radar (Namek)</translate> || {{L|Namek}} || <translate>Namek Dragon Balls</translate> || <translate>Crafted from Radar's Chips (Namek) and a Radar's CPU (Namek). Also the reward of Bulma's '''Namekian Research''' sidequest.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Bi-Dimensional Radar</translate> || <translate>Earth and Namek</translate> || <translate>Both sets</translate> || <translate>Not craftable. Bulma's '''Bi-Dimensional Radar''' sidequest fuses an Earth radar and a Namek radar into one.</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Using the radar ==

* Hold the radar in your main hand or off hand to see the radar display on screen.
* '''Right-click''' to switch its range. The Earth and Namek radars switch between '''150''' and '''300''' blocks; the Bi-Dimensional Radar also has a '''600'''-block range. After switching, the radar needs 16 seconds before you can switch again.
* Bulma's '''Signal Amplifier''' sidequest adds the 600-block range to your radars.
* Bulma's '''Tracker Display''' sidequest adds a readout of the distance to the closest Dragon Ball.
</translate>

<translate>
== Radar parts ==

The radars are built from four components. They are also used in many other DMZ recipes.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Part</translate> !! <translate>Recipe (crafting table)</translate>
|-
| <translate>Radar's Piece</translate> || <translate><code>S I S / I R I / S I S</code>: S is String, I is Iron Ingot, R is Redstone.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Radar's Chip (Earth)</translate> || <translate><code>R B R / G P G / R B R</code>: R is Redstone, B is Redstone Repeater, G is Green Concrete, P is Radar's Piece.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Radar's CPU (Earth)</translate> || <translate><code>R B R / C P C / R O R</code>: R is Redstone Comparator, B is Redstone Repeater, C is Radar's Chip (Earth), P is Radar's Piece, O is Observer.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Radar's Chip (Namek)</translate> || <translate><code>R O R / B P B / T T T</code>: R is Redstone Torch, O is Observer, B is Blue Concrete, P is Radar's Piece, T is Radar's CPU (Earth).</translate>
|-
| <translate>Radar's CPU (Namek)</translate> || <translate><code>R C R / T T T / O C O</code>: R is Redstone Comparator, C is Radar's Chip (Namek), T is Radar's CPU (Earth), O is Observer.</translate>
|}
<translate>
The radars themselves use the pattern <code>O C O / P G P / C P C</code>: O is Observer, C is the Radar's Chip of that world, G is the Radar's CPU of that world and P is Radar's Piece.

Other ways to get parts:

* [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Trader|Namekian Traders]] sell Radar's Chips (Namek).
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]] can grant 4 Radar's CPUs (Namek) as a wish.
</translate>

<translate>
=== Other recipes that use radar parts ===

* [[Special:MyLanguage/Scouters|Scouters]]: Radar's Piece and Radar's CPU (Earth).
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]]: Radar's Chips (Namek) and Radar's CPU (Namek).
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Gravity Device|Gravity Device]]: Radar's CPU (Earth).
* Dr. Kikono's Station: Radar's CPU (Namek). The Fuel Generator and Energy Cables: Radar's Chip (Earth). See [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor|Armor]].
* Some treasure maps of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistant]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Namekian|Capsule Corp Namekian]] cost a Radar's Chip (Earth).
</translate>
